issues: - Share-read rate limit identity trusts x-forwarded-for unconditionally even though Express is not configured for trusted proxies, so direct clients can rotate/spoof that header to bypass public share-read and failed-probe limits; tests only exercise x-forwarded-for as a trusted client address and do not cover spoofing/untrusted-header behavior. - FixedWindowRateLimiter never evicts expired entries for keys that do not return, so high-cardinality share-read traffic can grow the in-memory map indefinitely; no regression test covers expired-key cleanup.

- No automated regression verifies that buildApp() applies TRUST_PROXY to the Express trust proxy setting; the route tests manually call app.set('trust proxy', true), so the production env-to-Express wiring could regress while tests still pass.

summary: added dry-run-first data repair/backfill tooling for profile rows, learning saved-pack links, share token metadata, and quiz attempt sequence repairs

issues: - api/scripts/data-repair.ts recomputes quiz mastery repair rows with mastery_score=accuracy and mastery_delta=accuracy-previous_accuracy, but production saveQuizAttempt uses computeQuizMasteryTrend to combine accuracy with card_mastery_score and compare against previous mastery_score, so --apply can corrupt valid mastery data and dry-run can overreport healthy rows; - api/tests/dataRepair.test.ts only checks SQL strings and row counts, so no regression verifies the repair formula matches computeQuizMasteryTrend

- api/scripts/data-repair.ts still derives expected_previous_mastery_score with LAG(mastery_score) from existing stored rows, so if an earlier quiz attempt has corrupt mastery_score, later retake mastery_delta repairs are computed from the corrupt stored value instead of the repaired expected previous mastery score; - api/tests/dataRepair.test.ts asserts SQL substrings but does not cover a multi-attempt corrupted sequence where a later row must use the prior row's repaired mastery score, so this sequence-repair bug is not caught
